changelog: The first minute. The person who invited you is known from the start, so their first message reaches you while you work instead of waiting behind "1 person you have not written to". Setup ends with one line to send to the person you build with. And your sign-in no longer ends silently: from a week out, a new session tells you, with the one command that renews it.
features: npx slashvibe-mcp setup --from @them: your inviter is known from the start. Nothing is sent, no line is opened, and mute undoes it
Setup's last screen prints that line with your handle, for the person you build with
Your sign-in lasts 30 days: from 7 days out, a new session says how long is left and how to renew; if it has ended, it says that instead of going quiet
An installed session-start hook now updates itself with the package, so fixes reach people who installed earlier (it only ever rewrites its own line, and never installs one you removed)
